title: Confirming a meeting time sends every attendee a calendar invite and frees the other options

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: after a team picks a date there is no confirm step: the other pencils stay held until they lapse, and attendees get nothing to put in their own calendar. Fix: confirmTimeOption makes the winner the Plan's date, releases the rest of the option_group, and emails each attendee (members and EMAIL-092 voters) an .ics invite, as booking confirmations already do.

DONE 2026-11-24: confirmTimeOption (lib/calendar/time-confirm.ts) keeps the winning candidate through keep_pencil_date (the other options are soft-released, recoverable) and emails everyone who answered, the Plan lead, members and email voters alike, the date with an invite.ics attached (lib/calendar/time-confirm-ics.ts on the shared lib/events/ics.ts blocks, true instants in the Space zone, all-day as DATE values). Confirm this date in the Find a time panel; the Plan's record says what was released.

verify.note: Passes once lib/calendar exports confirmTimeOption and it sends an .ics invite.
